# Paean JS

> Open-source Paean / 8x game SDK with native three.js APIs, vector and skeletal 2D, outfits, and standardized pixel-game modules.

Package: @paean-ai/paean-js. SDK source: packages/paean-js/src. The root package is upstream three, not the Paean SDK. Runtime and types must use the exact version in paean/upstream.json. Read package.json for the current SDK version.

## Conventions

Use seconds, radians, and Y-up world coordinates. Atlas rectangles and serialized tile rows start at the top-left. One world unit is one pixel unless pixelsPerUnit is set. Dispose according to ownership. Read before writing cloud state. Consent and purchases occur only from intentional user actions; feed previews stay in demo mode. Never invent APIs, emulate paid ownership, or bundle a second three.js copy.
